Method of Attack: Intra-Library Collusion (ILC) attack spreading malicious actions across several apps using the same libraries to leverage different permissions

Malicious apps using shared libraries (advertising and analytics SDKs) to carry out spyware-like behavior such as collecting location data, call information, microphone access, and device storage access
Attack Vector: Use of shared libraries across multiple apps to collude and escalate privileges
Delivery of malicious code via advertising and analytics SDKs embedded in legitimate apps
Date of Discovery: Research paper released last month (relative to article date)
